An '''electrum helmet''' is a [[Armor#Helmet|helmet]] of the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tier, made by smithing a [[diamond helmet]] with [[electrum alloy]]. Worn, it wards off undead.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 3 armor and 3 toughness, with 1000 durability. Unlike netherite, electrum armor has no knockback resistance. Electrum uses a netherite item ID, so it does not burn in fire or lava. Piglins treat it as gold armor.

=== Set bonus ===
Each piece counts one level towards [[Warding]], so the full set gives warding 4, the only way to reach that level: it slows undead within 24 blocks, damages the nearest within 12, and pierces the protection of copper armor. Held warding items never raise the total above 3.

With all four pieces, the [[set bonus]] also grants {{Data/Set bonus|electrum_armour=4}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/divinity/electrum_armour.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/warding/power_4.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into an [[adamant alloy]], not electrum, because electrum shares the netherite item IDs. This makes melting electrum gear a way to turn an [[electrum alloy]] into an adamant alloy.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
{{Uses}}

An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[electrum alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/electrum_helmet.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.03|Electrum alloy now needs a [[divine fragment]].}}
{{History line|1.10|Electrum was buffed. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12|Fixed severe multiplayer lag caused by electrum armor.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal item in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Can only be repaired with blocks of diamond. The set bonus was reduced from 4 to 2 hearts.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|No longer burns in fire or lava, and counts as armor that piglins accept. Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
